test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Dr. Joyce is studying an experiment in his laboratory.

options.text: An experiment is studied by Dr. Joyce in his laboratory.
An experiment was being studied by Dr. Joyce in his laboratory.
An experiment is being studied by Dr. Joyce in his laboratory.
An experiment has been studied by Dr. Joyce in his laboratory.

solution:
The correct answer is **"An experiment is being studied by Dr. Joyce in his laboratory." (डॉ. जॉयस अपनी प्रयोगशाला में एक प्रयोग का अध्ययन कर रहे हैं।)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the Present Continuous Tense and in Active Voice. (दिया गया वाक्य वर्तमान काल में सतत रूप में है और सक्रिय वाचा में है। )
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Pass
